body:
## 中文

橙子日程 1.2.1：在「今天」列表直接查看计划备注。

- 有备注的计划下方新增一行灰色小字，短备注无需进入编辑界面即可阅读。
- 长备注显示省略号，鼠标悬停可查看备注内容；多行备注合并为单行预览，保存的原始内容保持不变。
- 同时适用于当天计划和逾期未完成事项。空白备注不额外占行，保留点击编辑、勾选完成和筛选操作。
- 支持中文和英文界面。

下载下方的 `OrangeSchedule-Setup-1.2.1.exe`。保存正在编辑的计划，从托盘退出旧版，再安装到原位置。Windows 10 / 11 x64，已有计划和语言设置继续保留。

SHA-256：`a8e4282517431f70b1b3ee42889e094ac905c51f1b65ff62d42261c1b1f052a2`

## English

Orange Schedule 1.2.1 adds inline note previews to **Today**.

- Tasks with notes show one line of smaller gray text beneath their details, so short notes can be read without opening the editor.
- Longer notes end with an ellipsis. Hover over a preview to see the note text. Line breaks are collapsed only for display; saved notes stay unchanged.
- Applies to today's tasks and overdue incomplete tasks. Blank notes do not add an empty row. Editing, completion and filters keep working as before.
- Available in both English and Chinese interfaces.

Download `OrangeSchedule-Setup-1.2.1.exe` below. Save your edits, quit the old app from the tray, and install to the same location. For Windows 10 / 11 x64. Existing plans and language preferences are retained.

SHA-256: `a8e4282517431f70b1b3ee42889e094ac905c51f1b65ff62d42261c1b1f052a2`
